CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_waj_wrong(p_class_id text, p_qid text, p_item jsonb, p_pt integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_section integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_qnum integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_qtype text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_level integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  insert into wrong_answer_journal
    (class_id, qid, pt, section, qnum, qtype, level, last_status, revisit_count, history_json)
  values
    (p_class_id, p_qid, p_pt, p_section, p_qnum, p_qtype, p_level, 'wrong', 0, jsonb_build_array(p_item))
  on conflict (class_id, qid) do update set
    history_json  = wrong_answer_journal.history_json || p_item,
    last_status   = 'wrong',
    revisit_count = jsonb_array_length(wrong_answer_journal.history_json),
    updated_at    = now();
$function$
functions.name: append_waj_wrong
